experience.title: experience
experience.description:
I'm a Game Developer with hands-on experience in Unity (2D & 3D) and C#, specializing in gameplay systems, physics optimization and the end-to-end game development lifecycle. I've designed and shipped 4+ interactive Unity games, achieving smooth 60fps performance and cutting load times by ~25% through rendering and asset-pipeline optimization.

Alongside game development, I bring experience as a Salesforce Software Engineer — building CRM solutions with Apex, Visualforce and SOQL, improving query performance by 35%, and shipping custom CRM Analytics dashboards and self-serve bulk data tools.

hard-skills.title: hard-skills
hard-skills.description:
As a Game Developer, I work daily with Unity (2D & 3D), C#, gameplay systems, physics, UI/UX and asset pipelines — building modular, reusable architectures that have cut feature development time by roughly 30%.

I'm also experienced with Salesforce CRM development (Apex, SOQL, Visualforce, CRM Analytics, Data Loader), containerization and infrastructure tools like Docker, Kubernetes and VMware, and I use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini daily to speed up coding, debugging and workflow automation.

soft-skills.title: soft-skills
soft-skills.description:
I bring more than just technical know-how — clear communication, sprint-driven delivery, and the ability to manage a project across its full lifecycle, from design through development, QA and release.

My cross-disciplinary background spanning game development, enterprise software and digital media gives me a well-rounded, creative approach to solving problems.

bio.title: bio
bio.description:
About me
I'm a Game Developer based in Kota, Rajasthan, specializing in Unity (2D & 3D) and C#, with additional experience as a Salesforce Engineer and digital content creator. I hold an MCA from Lovely Professional University and a BCA from Modi Institute of Management & Technology.

I love combining creativity with engineering — from building interactive gameplay systems to producing motion graphics and marketing videos — and I actively use AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini to accelerate my day-to-day workflow.

interests.title: interests
interests.description:
I'm constantly exploring new tools and technologies — from Unity and game design to AI-assisted development with Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini.

I'm also into motion graphics, video editing and animation (MAAC-certified), and enjoy tinkering with Docker, Kubernetes and virtualized environments.

education.title: education
education.description:
I completed my Master of Computer Applications (MCA) at Lovely Professional University (May 2019 – May 2022) and my Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) at Modi Institute of Management & Technology, University of Kota (2015 – 2018).

I also hold a Graphics Design & Animation certification from the Maya Academy of Advanced Cinematics (MAAC), Kota, where I specialized in motion graphics, video editing and 2D/3D animation.

files.high-school: Senior Secondary (12th, CBSE — Commerce) at Sir Padampat Singhania School, Kota, and Secondary (10th, CBSE) at Central Academy School, Kota.
files.university: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) — Lovely Professional University, and Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) — Modi Institute of Management & Technology, University of Kota.

sports.title: sports
sports.description:
Outside of work, I like to stay active and unwind — it keeps me sharp and balanced for the creative and technical demands of game development and video production.
It's also where I get a lot of inspiration for the physics and movement systems I build in Unity.

favorite-games.title: favorite-games
favorite-games.description:
As a Game Developer, gaming isn't just my profession — it's my passion. I enjoy playing and breaking down 2D and 3D titles to study their gameplay systems, physics and UI/UX, which directly inspires the games I build with Unity and C#.

Exploring new mechanics and design patterns is one of my favorite ways to stay creative and sharp.
